description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notify the Mid Year Fiscal Position Report - 2018
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the publication and availability of the Mid Year Fiscal Position Report 2018, issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. The content focuses on regulatory compliance with a specific legal statute (the Fiscal Management Act) and the statutory requirement to make this report available to the public. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it pertains to the implementation and notification requirements of existing legislation.
